title: Semis Game 3 Preview: Can the Liberty and Aces Do What No WNBA Team Has Done?
meta_description: Teams up 2-0 in a best-of-five WNBA series are 19-0. Turnovers sink the Liberty, rebounds sink the Aces. Picks for both Game 3s on Friday.
hook: The New York Liberty have won more quarters than the Atlanta Dream in this series, four to two, and they're still down 0-2. One column in the box score explains it, and it's the same column that decides whether Brooklyn sees a Game 4.
summary: Preview of both WNBA semifinal Game 3s on Friday, October 9, 2026: Dream at Liberty, 4:30 p.m. PT, Barclays Center, ESPN2 (ESPN game 401918299), and Valkyries at Aces, 6:30 p.m. PT, Michelob ULTRA Arena, Peacock and NBCSN (ESPN game 401918300). Written by the WNBA agent; body kept in its voice. Every number was checked against the Full Court Buckets game files for Games 1 and 2 and the ESPN box scores (401918295, 401918297, 401918296, 401918298). Edits for accuracy: the hook now says the Liberty won four quarters to two (Atlanta's third period win was overtime), the turnover totals say they include team turnovers, and the last line now says the Aces lost the glass 52-25 in Game 1 instead of 'by 30 again'. The opener line and the 'what the highlight packages aren't telling you' tease were cut so the intro is one short hook. Three original stat boards sit inline where the draft placed them. Update Oct 8, 11:30 PM PT: added the WNBA agent's 'For the bettors and fantasy players' section with a betting board and a fantasy board. Every line was re-pulled from ESPN's DraftKings odds at 11:30 PM PT and matched the 11:29 PM PT check. Game 1 and 2 lines, cover results and totals, and every fantasy average, DraftKings points per game and per-36 figure were recomputed from our game files. The odds sentence now gives the date, the exact as-of time in PT and says lines may move, and links both ESPN game pages. The 21+, Gamble responsibly, 1-800-GAMBLER line is kept in the text and on both boards. No sportsbook or affiliate links and no call to action to bet.
hero_image_alt: Jordin Canada of the Atlanta Dream lines up a free throw at Target Center in Minneapolis
hero_image_credit: Photo: John Mac / CC BY-SA 4.0. Wikimedia Commons File:260527 Lynx Dream JohnMc210 (55298398176).jpg, Lynx vs Dream at Target Center on 2026-05-27, Commons category Jordin Canada, license reviewed by FlickreviewR 2. Not from this series; the caption says so.
unique: The Liberty won four quarters to the Dream's two and still trail 0-2, because Atlanta has taken 26 more shots on 38-22 turnovers and 20-12 offensive rebounds
Points off turnovers across both games: Dream 60, Liberty 24, a 36-point swing in a series Atlanta leads by 13
Series plus-minus: Reese +18, Canada +17, Hillmon +16; Fauthoux is the only Liberty player above zero. Wilson and Gray are both -11 despite Wilson's 48 points
Valkyries +14 in first halves, Aces +1 in second halves, with 27-8 offensive rebounds and a 61-21 bench edge
Three original stat boards built from our own game files and checked against ESPN
Game 3 betting and fantasy sheets: both series 2-0 against the spread for the leaders, Dream-Liberty overs 2-0, and DraftKings points per game and per-36 sleepers computed from our own box scores
unverified: Both picks (Dream win Game 3, Aces win Game 3) are opinion.

Allisha Gray 'questionable' is from ESPN's Thursday story; ESPN's game page lists her day-to-day. Loyd and Talbot day-to-day is from ESPN's game page as of Thursday evening. Re-check injury status before publishing Friday.

Points off turnovers, fast-break points, points in the paint and bench points are not stored in our game files; they come from the ESPN box scores. Turnover totals (38-22, 29-18) are ESPN's total turnovers, which include team turnovers; our game files store player turnovers only (35-20, 25-17).
The site's standard disclosure line for game stories says AI drafted it 'so it could post the same night'. That wording comes from the site generator and fits recaps better than a preview.
The lead photo is from May 27, 2026, not from this series.

Odds are DraftKings as listed on ESPN as of Thu, Oct 8, 2026, 11:29 PM PT (re-checked unchanged at 11:30 PM PT). Lines will move before Friday's tips; the boards are images, so re-check and refresh them if Ryan publishes much later.
Game 1 and 2 lines are the DraftKings lines ESPN lists on those game pages now (presumably closing lines); opening lines may have differed.

Fantasy points use DraftKings scoring as stated on the board and are computed from rounded box-score minutes. Kayla Thornton is 22.25 per game, shown as 22.3. Tiffany Hayes's 47.2 per 36 comes from 28 total minutes, which the text now says.

AdSense: informational odds with a responsible-gambling line and opinion leans. No sportsbook, affiliate or promo links and no 'bet now' language. The section names DraftKings only as the odds source. Low risk; the 'Dream plus the points' lean is the most betting-forward line, so Ryan can cut the leans paragraph if he wants zero gambling advice during the AdSense review.

categories.name: Accuracy
categories.reason: Every number, name and date in the title, meta, hook, body, board alt text and schema was checked against our game files for Games 1 and 2 and the four ESPN box scores, plus ESPN game pages 401918299 and 401918300 for times, venues, TV and injuries, ESPN's 19-0 note and the AP defending-champion line. Three fixes: quarters won is four to two (overtime was Atlanta's third period), turnover totals include team turnovers, and Game 1's rebound gap was 52-25, not 30. All three boards match ESPN, including the quarter board, which does not use the bad 7 and 23 Aces quarters from the old game file. Betting and fantasy section: all 6 Game 3 odds, 4 prior lines, ATS and over/under results, 12 player averages and fantasy figures, and the injury notes match ESPN and our game files.

categories.name: Information gain
categories.reason: Two-game series totals, the quarters-won paradox, points off turnovers, series plus-minus, and first-half vs second-half margins are not in the wire previews. Named in unique. The betting and fantasy sheets add per-36 sleepers and series ATS results computed from our own box scores.

categories.name: Main content and layout
categories.reason: Title and H1 match and don't exaggerate (no team has come back from 0-2). Lead photo under the headline, one short hook, then the series board right under the first subhead. Disclosure and box-score links at the bottom. No placeholders.

Odds are dated with the exact as-of time in PT, say lines may move, name the source, and carry the 21+ and 1-800-GAMBLER line.
